paragraphs: Greenshine New Energy supplies off-grid solar lighting for public and commercial infrastructure projects, and is described as a lighting brand of Ample New Energies. Its solar LED systems are sold for streets and roadways. Other lines are aimed at parking lots and at parks and public open spaces.

The company says it supports buyers from site analysis and lighting design through procurement documentation, installation and after-sales service. Each system is customized for the environment, temperature and sunlight duration of the local area. Going off-grid is presented as avoiding the digging that a grid connection requires. A Bluetooth control product lets users change light settings instead of running a fixed sunup to sundown profile.

The site lists buyer segments such as military facilities alongside its commercial and municipal work. A testimonial credited to a lighting lead for the City of Mammoth Lakes calls the company a preferred solar light vendor. Equipment financing is offered through a partnership with a direct lender. The team is described as having more than 30 years of combined experience developing outdoor solar lighting. Contact details give an office in Santa Ana, California.

quote.text: Greenshine, a lighting brand of Ample New Energies, provides verifiable off-grid solar lighting for public and commercial infrastructure projects.
